bullets.text: Velachery floods persist despite 32.6 km of drainage infrastructure, and the office should monitor drainage effectiveness.
Commuters face hardship as trains run to St. Thomas Mount but do not stop at Adambakkam, so the office must check rail operations.
Over 3,000 Avadi streetlights are non-functional despite a maintenance contract, and the office should inspect municipal lighting performance.
Auto workers protested against the Vetri Payanam scheme, and the office should review their livelihood concerns regarding the project.
Vultr plans to deploy a 20 MW supercluster in Chennai, and the office should support this data center expansion.

stories.title: Why Velachery Floods Persist Despite Chennai’s Drain Network
takeaways: Velachery received Rs 47.5 crore for 32.6 km of drainage infrastructure.
Residents continue to face severe flooding despite completed stormwater drain projects.

stories.title: Avadi Streetlights Fail Despite ₹22-Crore Maintenance Contract
takeaways: Over 3000 Avadi streetlights remain non-functional despite a Rs 22-crore maintenance contract.
The failure creates severe safety hazards for residents navigating waterlogged roads.
stories.snippet: More than 3,000 Avadi streetlights are reportedly non-functional despite a ₹22-crore maintenance contract awarded by Avadi Corporation in May, leaving several roads poorly lit as rain, waterlogging and potholes increase…

Union leaders urged the government to reconsider and modify the proposed transportation initiative.

stories.title: Vultr plans to develop a 20 MW supercluster in Chennai
takeaways: Cloud firm Vultr announced plans to develop a 20 MW supercluster in Chennai.
The project expands the firm's data centre footprint and strengthens local cloud capabilities.
